name: How do I choose the right contractor for my home addition?

mainEntity.name: How do I choose the right contractor for my home addition?

acceptedAnswer.text: Choosing the right contractor is crucial for a successful home addition. Look for contractors with extensive experience in home additions, verifiable licenses, and comprehensive insurance. Review their portfolio of past projects, and always ask for references from previous clients. Pay attention to communication style and professionalism during initial consultations. A reputable contractor will provide a detailed proposal, a clear timeline, and a transparent breakdown of costs. Interview several contractors, compare their bids, and ensure you feel comfortable with their approach and ability to meet your vision and budget. Longevity in business within your service area, such as Orange County, can also be a good indicator.
acceptedAnswer.description: Choose a contractor with experience, licenses, insurance, strong references, clear communication, and a detailed proposal. Verify their portfolio and compare bids carefully.
